summary: No substantiated high- or medium-severity logic defect remains in the final hashed P2 DaemonControl/EventStream implementation. This is a scoped review, not a claim that all P2 services or stage exit criteria are complete.

reviewed_properties.property: bounded stream send and shutdown completion
evidence: session-daemon-go/internal/grpcapi/events.go:301 starts one transport Send per subscription and returns on send completion, stream cancellation, or a server timer; the RPC return cancels the gRPC stream context.

session-daemon-go/internal/grpcapi/slow_reader_test.go exercises an actual TCP/HTTP2 client that never receives and checks that the subscription and sender leave after the server deadline without stopping daemon control.
session-daemon-go/internal/grpcapi/server.go:72 signals shutdown only from server stats.End after an accepted response; transport failure cancels the provisional shutdown gate.
session-daemon-go/cmd/astrorder-sessiond/shutdown.go:12 bounds GracefulStop and falls back to Stop; main.go waits for shutdownDone before process return.
session-daemon-go/internal/events/subscription.go:21 takes commitGate exclusively, registers the subscriber, and reads durable session high-water marks in the same barrier.
session-daemon-go/internal/grpcapi/events.go:88 binds expected_daemon_id, replays only through each captured MaxSeqID, emits LiveReady watermarks, then drains queued post-barrier events.
Existing tests cover more than 128 sessions, paged replay, events and new sessions created during replay, expired/ahead cursors, epoch changes, and subscription overflow.
session-daemon-go/internal/protocol/facade.go:69 fails closed when durable event or operation authority cannot be read.
session-daemon-go/internal/protocol/facade.go:134 establishes daemon and runtime admission gates before checking pending operations and authoritative sessions.

session-daemon-go/internal/protocol/admission.go and internal/runtime/shutdown.go reject new control/runtime work after provisional shutdown acceptance and release the gate on failed transport completion.
Expected daemon identity is checked before shutdown and replay; registered runtime busy state and non-idle/error-ambiguous sessions prevent unconfirmed shutdown.
contracts/proto/astrorder/sessiond/v1/sessiond.proto:835 defines native_payload alongside the typed oneof.

session-daemon-go/internal/grpcapi/events.go:229 marshals the complete stored payload into native_payload for every event, including typed runtime.owner, runtime.ownership_lost, and pty.output branches.
session-daemon-go/internal/protocol/facade.go:232 decodes incoming native JSON with json.Decoder.UseNumber.
session-daemon-go/internal/grpcapi/native_payload_test.go covers typed and unknown events, unknown nested fields, and integers beyond JavaScript's exact range.
session-daemon-go/internal/grpcapi/server.go:138 applies the same bearer verification to unary and streaming RPCs using subtle.ConstantTimeCompare.
NewServer registers only DaemonControl and EventStream, and GetCapabilities advertises exactly those two implemented services.

resolved_during_review.issue: The initial send timeout measured elapsed time only after a synchronous Send returned, so a permanently blocked Send was not bounded.
resolved_during_review.final_state: resolved in the final hash set
resolved_during_review.minimal_fix: Run at most one Send in flight, select on its result, stream context, and a server timer, then let handler return cancel the transport context.

resolved_during_review.issue: Typed event branches initially discarded native fields not modeled by protobuf.
resolved_during_review.final_state: resolved in the final hash set
resolved_during_review.minimal_fix: Carry the complete losslessly decoded payload in EventEnvelope.native_payload in addition to the typed projection.

resolved_during_review.issue: Shutdown authorization was initially a point-in-time check and allowed new runtime dispatch before process shutdown began.
resolved_during_review.final_state: resolved in the final hash set
resolved_during_review.minimal_fix: Close daemon and registry admission atomically before authority checks; roll the provisional gate back if authorization or response transport fails.

resolved_during_review.issue: A failed legacy WebSocket shutdown-response write could initially leave the daemon alive but permanently draining.
resolved_during_review.final_state: resolved in the final hash set
resolved_during_review.minimal_fix: Cancel the provisional admission gate whenever an accepted shutdown response fails transport completion; keep it closed only after shutdown is signaled.
resolved_during_review.executable_test: Add a deterministic failing WebSocket writer test that accepts shutdown, forces response-write failure, and verifies a later control is admitted.

results.result: runtime and grpcapi passed; protocol exposed the shutdown-admission race, which was then fixed in the final hash set
cmd/astrorder-sessiond and protocol passed; grpcapi build was blocked by a concurrently added out-of-scope operation_test.go referring to RegisterOperationQuery before its implementation landed
not cleanly repeatable against the final hash set because concurrent operation-query work was incomplete; no broad race run was duplicated

suggestions: After the concurrent OperationQuery files settle, rerun go test and go vet for ./cmd/astrorder-sessiond, ./internal/grpcapi, and ./internal/protocol against the exact final hashes.
Add a deterministic legacy WebSocket shutdown response-write failure test to lock in admission rollback symmetry with the gRPC stats.End error path.
Keep the real slow TCP reader test; the fake blocked stream test alone does not prove transport-context cancellation after handler return.

source_identity.note: The scoped implementation is uncommitted/new, so commit identity alone is insufficient. These SHA-256 values identify the final reviewed files.

limitations: This review covers the current DaemonControl/EventStream adapter, shared authority, replay barrier, event payload preservation, and shutdown paths. It does not assert full P2 service completion.
The working tree changed during review. Findings and pass status apply only to the final listed hashes.
A clean final package-wide grpcapi test/vet rerun was blocked by unrelated concurrent OperationQuery work that was incomplete at review close.
No WSL race suite was run because a separate coordinator job was already running it.
